name: cockpit
description: A calm control surface: chat fill, cache warmth and plan pace above the prompt, and a Control Center pane with forecasts, subagents, keep-warm, handoff and a launcher.

compactAt.title: Compact point (tokens)
compactAt.description: Where Claude shrinks the chat by itself. 0 reads your autoCompactWindow setting, else 400000.

cacheLife.title: Cache life
cacheLife.description: auto: 1 hour on a subscription, 5 minutes on an API key.

density.title: Band density
density.description: calm shows the three facts only; standard adapts to the width; full adds the bar and the weekly limit sooner.

keepWarm.title: Keep the cache warm by default
keepWarm.description: Starts each session with keep-warm on. Each ping is a small model request.

keepWarmHours.title: Keep-warm window (hours)
keepWarmHours.description: How long keep-warm runs once turned on.

guardTokens.title: Cold-send guard (tokens)
guardTokens.description: Stop the first message after the cache goes cold when the chat is at least this big. 0 turns the guard off.

openAtStart.title: Open the Control Center in every chat
openAtStart.description: Opens the Control Center beside each new chat. A terminal shows it from 144 columns wide.
